subject: Tomorrow's headcount deadline
text:
Hi,

I wanted to share a few details before the weekend. The venue has confirmed our original time, but we now have a tighter deadline for final headcounts because the caterer adjusted their cutoff. If you can send your number by tomorrow afternoon, I will include you in the main list. The address is unchanged, and there will be a small registration desk at the entrance. Please tell me as soon as possible if anything prevents you from joining, since I need to notify them early. I would rather not leave you off.
